𝐁𝐑𝐀𝐃 𝐏𝐈𝐓𝐓 𝐀𝐒 𝐂𝐋𝐈𝐅𝐅 𝐁𝐎𝐎𝐓𝐇 𝐈𝐒 𝐁𝐀𝐂𝐊!⁣ 🔥 
⁣
Set eight years after the events of Once Upon a Time... in Hollywood (2019), 𝐓𝐡𝐞 𝐅𝐮𝐫𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐫 𝐌𝐢𝐬-𝐀𝐝𝐯𝐞𝐧𝐭𝐮𝐫𝐞𝐬 𝐨𝐟 𝐂𝐥𝐢𝐟𝐟 𝐁𝐨𝐨𝐭𝐡 takes us back to Hollywood in 1977, where the former stuntman now works as a fixer, navigating the darker side of the entertainment industry.⁣
⁣
Written by Quentin Tarantino and directed by David Fincher, bringing together two of the most distinctive filmmaking voices in modern cinema. The film also marks the fourth feature collaboration between Fincher and Pitt, following Se7en (1995), Fight Club (1999) and The Curious Case of Benjamin Button (2008).⁣
⁣
Pitt stars alongside Elizabeth Debicki, Scott Caan, Carla Gugino, Yahya Abdul-Mateen II and Peter Weller.⁣
⁣
𝐓𝐡𝐞 𝐅𝐮𝐫𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐫 𝐌𝐢𝐬-𝐀𝐝𝐯𝐞𝐧𝐭𝐮𝐫𝐞𝐬 𝐨𝐟 𝐂𝐥𝐢𝐟𝐟 𝐁𝐨𝐨𝐭𝐡 arrives in IMAX on November 25, 2026, before hitting Netflix on December 23, 2026.⁣
